answer_1.quote: LVLMs excel at converting complex visual patterns into coherent linguistic representations, leading to significant performance improvements in visual question answering and cross-modal understanding tasks.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the effectiveness of our GTHM in VH mitigation on four popular benchmarks: (1) quantitative metrics CHAIR on MSCOCO dataset; (2) the Polling-based Object Probing Evaluation (POPE) on the MSCOCO dataset; (3) general-purposed Multimodal Large Language Model Evaluation (MME) benchmark; (4) qualitative evaluation benchmark LLaVABench.
